title: Steamed Ochazuke with Japanese Fish
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese dish made with steamed rice and topped with fish and green tea broth.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly and cook according to the package instructions.
Meanwhile, prepare the green tea broth by steeping the green tea leaves in 2 cups of hot water.
Strain the green tea broth and mix with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Cut the fish into thin slices and set aside.
To serve, place a scoop of cooked Japanese rice in a bowl, followed by a few slices of fish.
Pour the green tea broth over the fish and rice, and garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and grated daikon (if using).
